info.title: LemonadeX Authentication and Administration API
info.description: Feature-based Spring MVC API for authentication, administrator accounts, roles and customers. JWT lifetime is 15 minutes. Every authenticated request checks current account status and database roles/permissions.

post.summary: Create missing color x size variants
post.description: Requires ADMIN role and PRODUCT_WRITE. Existing combinations are skipped and deleted combinations are restored. SKUs are PRODUCTCODE-COLORCODE-SIZECODE; values over 100 characters use a 67-character prefix and a 32-character suffix derived from combination IDs. Returns the created variants. All changes roll back if any combination fails. Catalog writes are serialized in a PostgreSQL transaction to protect references and concurrent restores.

get.description: Called by VNPay (register this URL in the VNPay merchant portal). Verifies the HMAC-SHA512 signature and amount, settles the payment once and answers {RspCode, Message}: 00 confirmed, 01 unknown reference, 02 already confirmed, 04 wrong amount, 97 bad signature, 99 error.

post.description: Called by MoMo at PAYMENT_CALLBACK_BASE_URL/api/v1/payments/momo/ipn. Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature and amount, settles once; 204 when accepted, 400 otherwise.

post.summary: Result after the shopper returns from the gateway
post.description: Public. The shop's /shop/payment/{gateway} page forwards the query parameters the gateway appended. Verified like the IPN and settles the payment if the IPN has not yet (whichever arrives first wins).

429.description: Too many requests from this client; see Retry-After.

Requires SHIPMENT_READ. Whether the GHTK token and pick-up address are configured.

post.summary: Hand a confirmed order to GHTK
post.description: Requires SHIPMENT_WRITE. Creates the GHTK order (shop pays the fee, GHTK collects the unpaid balance) and records the shipment with GHTK's label as tracking code. 409 CARRIER_NOT_CONFIGURED / CARRIER_REJECTED / CARRIER_UNAVAILABLE / ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED.

409.description: Conflicting state, stock, payment or refund limit.

post.description: Called by GHTK at .../api/v1/carriers/ghtk/webhook?hash=GHTK_WEBHOOK_SECRET with label_id and status_id (form or JSON). Moves the shipment through the normal workflow: 3 SHIPPED, 4/10 IN_TRANSIT, 5/6 DELIVERED, 9 FAILED, 11/21 RETURNED, -1 CANCELLED. Unknown labels are ignored.
